prompt:
This photo was taken by a seller at a New Zealand garage sale. Buyers will search the sale by item.

List every item or clearly grouped lot a buyer could pick up and buy. Group near-identical small things (for example "box of paperbacks", "set of 6 glasses") instead of listing each one. Do not list fixtures that aren't for sale, such as the garage door, the car or the house.

For each item give:
- label: a short name a buyer would recognise, with brand or era when visible ("Makita cordless drill", "1970s Crown Lynn vase").
- category: one of Furniture, Tools, Books, Electronics, Clothing, Kitchen, Garden, Toys, Free, Other.
- description: one or two plain sentences on what it is and its visible condition. Don't guess prices.
- search_terms: 3 to 8 words or phrases a New Zealand buyer might type, including Kiwi words where they fit (chilly bin, jandals, bach, ute, tramping).
- highlight: true for the few items most likely to draw buyers.
- confidence: how sure you are the item is what you say.
- box: where the item is, as whole numbers from 0 to 1000 relative to the image width (x) and height (y), top-left is 0,0.

privacy_flags: list any visible faces, readable number plates, documents with personal details, screens showing personal content, or medication.
summary: one sentence describing the sale in this photo.

answer.summary: A mixed lot of well-used shed and garden gear, including two garden sieves, string lines, twine, pliers, a file, timber offcuts, rags and loose roofing screws.

items.label: White plastic garden sieve with mesh
items.description: Large white plastic garden riddle or soil sieve with fine metal mesh and a long handle. It is dirty and well used but looks intact.

items.label: Red garden sieve with metal mesh
items.description: Round red plastic sieve with metal mesh and a bolt fitting on the rim. It is dusty from use.

items.label: Long wooden pole / tool handle
items.description: Long, thin wooden pole or spare tool handle. It is weathered and grubby.

items.label: Ball of cotton twine on handle
items.description: Large ball of natural cotton or jute twine wound onto a black handle. It looks clean and usable.

items.label: Orange-handled pliers / snips
items.description: Long-handled pliers or snips with orange-painted handles and black steel jaws. The paint is worn and there is some surface rust.

items.label: Metal file / rasp
items.description: Long flat metalworking file or rasp. It is dusty and well used.

items.label: Wooden tool handle
items.description: Thick, weathered wooden handle, possibly from a hammer, axe or mallet.

items.label: Fluoro yellow builder's string line
items.description: Roll of bright yellow builder's string line on a spool. It looks fairly full.

items.label: Green garden twine
items.description: Ball of green garden twine. It is partly hidden in the pile.

items.label: Plywood offcut
items.description: Square-ish plywood offcut with paint or plaster marks on it.

items.label: Weathered timber frame pieces
items.description: Grey weathered timber lengths, possibly a small frame or parts of a stool or sawhorse.

items.label: Cutting / grinding discs
items.description: A few small abrasive cutting or grinding discs for an angle grinder.

items.label: Copper pipe offcuts
items.description: A couple of short copper-coloured pipe pieces. They may be copper plumbing pipe.

items.label: Cotton rags / drop cloths
items.description: Pile of frayed grey and white cotton cloths. Useful as workshop rags.

items.label: Lot of roofing tek screws and bolts
items.description: Loose collection of galvanised roofing tek screws, hex-head screws and bolts. Some are dusty.

items.label: Black rubber wheel / tyre
items.description: Edge of a black rubber wheel or tyre. It is only partly visible.
